Those born with the '''spark''', known within the fandom as '''"sparkers"''', are people who not only have the ability to [[channel]] with experienced guidance but will inevitably begin to channel with or without training.{{ref/book|1|21}} Three out of four women with the spark do not survive this learning process on their own.{{ref/book|1|21}} Most who do not receive formal training (called [[wilder]]s by [[Aes Sedai]]) either die or achieve a rudimentary control, often accompanied by unconscious [[block]]s preventing them from hurting themselves by drawing too much and [[severing|burning themselves out]].{{ref/book|1|21}} In much of the Westlands, a family will readily send a daughter to the [[White Tower]] if she shows signs of channeling. This holds true even among those who dislike the [[Aes Sedai]], such as in [[Tear]]{{ref/book|0|2}} and [[Amadicia]]{{verify}}.

The [[White Tower]] would ideally find and train every girl born with the spark in the [[Westlands]] both to save the girl from the dangers and to claim her too boost the Tower's dwindling numbers. In practice, the Tower does not succeed in finding very many girls at all - neither those with a spark nor those who have the ability to learn - and many channelers born with the spark become wilders in the Westlands. [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] is one such woman; she was born with the spark and began channeling long before the opportunity for training was presented. She and [[Sharina Melloy]] were the two most powerful female channelers alive (apart from the Forsaken) as far as most Aes Sedai are aware, and the fact that their existence would have eluded the Tower's grasp under normal circumstances speaks to the Tower's failure in finding channelers. Other channelers of notable ability who would not have been found by the Tower under normal circumstances would be [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Nicola Treehill]], and [[Bodewhin Cauthon]]; all of these women are more powerful channelers than any Aes Sedai to be seen in years.

==Manifesting the spark==
===Women===
A woman born with the spark will unavoidably begin to manifest her ability (assuming she survives her younger years), which usually happens in her early teen years. After the first touching of the [[True Source]], the channeler will experience a reaction less than ten days later. She will experience violent shivers, headaches, bouts of mania, numbness, dizziness, and many other possible symptoms. The next time she channels ''saidar,'' the ill effects will occur sooner after the incident, and subsequent times they affect the person closer to the actual time of touching until it happens almost at the same time. At that point the visible symptoms stop, and control must be learned (likely in the form of a block) or death soon follows. In as short a time as one year or as many as five the channeler will fall to the ground screaming and convulsing. Once this happens not even the [[One Power]] can save them. It is also reasonable to assume that all [[wilder]]s are born with the spark as the chances of finding a teacher outside of the White Tower to coax the ability out of them is virtually non-existent. However, there are rare instances, such as the [[Daughters of Silence]], where it is possible someone without the spark *may* have been trained to the point of channeling and would be considered a wilder by the White Tower.

===Men===
Men can also learn to channel on their own, although they usually manifest this trait later than women. Men may not show any sign until their mid-twenties, such as [[Mazrim Taim]]. Until recently, the [[taint]] has long been an additional difficulty facing those men who do achieve some degree of control. With the cleansing of ''saidin'' and the establishing of the [[Black Tower]], the risks have been alleviated somewhat and are more akin to dangers of touching ''saidar'' unguided.

==Strength==
Having been born with the inherent spark apparently was not an indicator of strength. There were as many with weak potential who would channel whether they were taught or not as there were with great potential.{{ref/book|c|strength in the One Power}} Although we see several strong channelers like [[Alivia]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], and [[Aviendha]] born with the spark, others like [[Nicola Treehill]] and [[Sharina Melloy]] were not.

==Seanchan==
In [[Seanchan]] women who are born with the spark are held by an ''[[a'dam]]'' and made into ''[[damane]]''. They are controlled by ''[[sul'dam]]'' who collar them and treat them like beasts, not knowing that the ''sul'dam'' themselves are women who can be taught to channel.

==List of "Sparkers"==

The following is a list of [[wilder]]s (who are presumed to have the spark) and people known to be born with the spark. While not necessarily listed here, all known ''[[damane]]'' (except some collared [[Aes Sedai]]) and virtually all men who developed the ability to channel from the [[Breaking of the World]] until the founding of the [[Black Tower]] were also born with the spark.
